title: Unbounded memoization or class-level caches
summary: Memoization and class-level caches without bounds can leak memory over time.
rationale: Ruby services and Rails apps often live long enough for request-keyed or user-keyed memoization to grow indefinitely.

impact.notes: Impact increases in hot paths, large collections, high-traffic Rails actions, background jobs, or repeated request paths.

remediation.guidance: Use bounded caches, request-local storage, explicit invalidation, TTLs, or avoid memoizing values with unbounded key spaces.
remediation.tradeoffs: May require refactoring for readability, query shape, or framework conventions.
